mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% per annum, it triggers a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and declines in UNRATE signal an overheating economy where aggressive rate hikes suppress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and forces aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,200,000 units per month signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal synchronized demand and supply expansion that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 0.5%) signals an economic slowdown that reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
